items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Landratsamt Musterbreisgau, Stadtstraße 2, 79104 Musterfreiburg, Widerspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter contains two conflicting dates: the Bescheid itself is dated 08.07.2025 (Tuesday), but the cover letter carrying it is dated 11.07.2025 (Friday). Under § 41 (L)VwVfG, a notice sent by ordinary mail is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after it was handed to the postal service (Aufgabe zur Post), counting from the day after dispatch. Scenario A (using the Bescheid date 08.07.2025 as the dispatch day): day+1=09.07 (Wed), +2=10.07 (Thu), +3=11.07 (Fri) -> Bekanntgabe = 11.07.2025. Scenario B (using the letter's own date 11.07.2025 as the dispatch day): day+1=12.07 (Sat), +2=13.07 (Sun), +3=14.07 (Mon) -> Bekanntgabe = 14.07.2025. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day. Scenario A: begins 12.07.2025, ends 11.08.2025 (Monday, not a BW public holiday). Scenario B: begins 15.07.2025, ends 14.08.2025 (Thursday). Because the two possible starting dates in the letter contradict each other, the earliest plausible deadline (Scenario A) is used: 11.08.2025.
